A real ducktape view component, used by the tests that need a valid
`ducktape:view@0.1.0` artifact without building one.

Source: ducktape-app, the smallest view in its set (members-view), built by
        that repository's view target and copied here.
SHA-256: 36ad3a6e029e1ef6c08f32abd307384f02ccc9b7ed2145d5e2bd095fd9480c5a

It carries the `ducktape.view.manifest` custom section holding
`ducktape.view.manifest.v1` text, which is what the readiness and
view-registration tests read. Any view works: re-copy from whichever one is
smallest if this ever needs refreshing, and update the digest above.

`object.component.wasm` beside it is the object-storage test tenant the
composer suite admits under an arbitrary module id. It is a test guest no
network founds, which is why it is here and not in the kernel fixture set
`crates/kernel/host/tests/declared_shapes.rs` pins.
